**Iraq: how applications changed.** The extract records 1,653,234 applications during 2000–2025. Annual volume peaked at 215,388 in 2015, compared with 30,105 in 2025. Applications in 2025 were 52% lower than in 2019 (62,448). Applications in 2025 were 14% lower than in 2024 (35,016). In 2025, the leading destinations were Germany (14,605; 49%), United Kingdom (2,848; 9.5%), Greece (2,745; 9.1%). Germany received 49% of this origin's applications in 2025, versus 25% in 2019: a change in destination distribution, not evidence that the same people moved between asylum systems.

Across receiving countries, in 2025, the substantive protection rate was 27%, across 27,701 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 32% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 7.7 percentage points lower than in 2024 (35%).
